objective: Execute the Public Alpha Harvest + Cross-Dataset Backfill sequentially, preserve source provenance and falsifiers, and convert only replicated point-in-time-clean findings into prospective Meme Alpha shadow hypotheses.

ian05012_solana_memecoin_dataset.role: G2/G3 wallet/funding and detection-time snapshot research

smugcalls.role: external tail benchmark and temporal peak reconstruction

research_heads.DISCOVERY: capital path, entity structure, wallet convergence, creator/funder history, lore/provenance and early propagation
research_heads.RUNNER: 3m/5m/10m/15m continuation and survival conditional on an already-qualified candidate
research_heads.TAIL: remaining 10x/25x/50x/100x convexity with regime, saturation, liquidity and propagation controls
research_heads.EXITABILITY: realizable exit, direct depth, slippage, survival and round-trip prevention

hard_rules: No retrospective feature receives live BUY_NOW authority directly.
All wallet quality must be reconstructed AS-OF the candidate cutoff where feasible.
Exact chain + CA/mint identity is mandatory.
Unknown or missing source state must remain UNKNOWN, not negative evidence.
Full-denominator or matched-failure controls are required before interpreting apparent winner features.
Theoretical peak and realizable return are separate outcomes.
Public-source mining is limited to lawfully public artifacts. No authentication, paywall, private/deleted-data, robots or rate-limit bypass.
Large external datasets are pinned by revision/hash and processed through bounded research workflows rather than copied into control-plane Git.
Nulls, failed hypotheses and missed winners are first-class research outputs.
promotion_gate: source-specific leakage and bias audit passes
prospective Alpha Lab shadow cohort confirms direction and calibration
sellability/liquidity/exitability are independently verified for return claims
